message.subject: Extending Weathershield's premium positioning
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congratulations on the Pinnacle Award for your anti-graffiti film—that's impressive recognition.

I'm reaching out because we work with protective film manufacturers who are looking to expand into ultra-premium segments where customers need extended outdoor performance guarantees. Given Weathershield's strong market position, I thought you might be interested in how some of your peers are using our overlaminate to compete in higher-value architectural and fleet projects that demand longer lifecycles.

Would it be helpful if I sent over a brief overview of how this works? Happy to keep it focused on what's relevant for your distributor network.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Drytac's recent Pinnacle Product Award for anti-graffiti technology demonstrates innovation momentum
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Extended outdoor performance enabling expansion into ultra-premium architectural and fleet segments that Drytac's current 5-7 year products cannot address
